_comment: Advisories `npm audit` reports that do not fail CI, checked by scripts/check-audit.mjs. npm can only suppress by severity, never by advisory, so without this file one unfixable finding would force the whole high-severity gate down. An entry is only justified when there is no patched version to upgrade to AND the vulnerable code path is unreachable from this project — record the reachability argument in `reason`, not just the fact that it's inconvenient. `expires` is a hard deadline: past it, CI fails until someone re-checks whether a fix has shipped.
